::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Incubated at IIT Delhi's FITT, designing semiconductor chips that operate at cryogenic temperatures — the control electronics that quantum computers, space and defence systems need. Early stage; no tape-out publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Cryogenic CMOS integrated circuits for quantum-computer control, space and defence applications.
